title: Limited ability of LLMs to simulate human psychological behaviours: a psychometric analysis

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating 'trait bias' (the absolute difference between LLM-generated personality scores and ground-truth human scores) to demonstrate that the models systematically skew outputs toward socially desirable personality traits, such as high agreeableness, high conscientiousness, and low neuroticism.

Correlating the personality simulation inaccuracy ('trait bias') with demographic variables from a ground-truth dataset—including age, sex, ethnicity, income, and education—to evaluate if the model is systematically worse at simulating specific demographic groups.
